info.title: Credit MVP internal contracts
info.description: Implement only MS1 and MS2. EXTERNAL-B and EXTERNAL-MS3 paths are contracts for other owners. Money input: integer RUB; loan annual rates: percentages, 24 = 24%, range 0..100 inclusive, at most two decimal places. Internal policy rates and ratios remain fractions. Scoring v2: raw named questionnaire inputs (750), internally computed economics (250); B uses named BalanceShit and ProfitAndLoss fields.

post.description: A calls MS1. An absent model_version selects the fixed legacy v2 for the borrower type; an explicit version must exist in the compiled catalog. MS1 checks early stops, obtains one aggregate supplier block when needed, checks supplier stops, then obtains legal-entity reports from B, scores and selects one deal. X-Scoring-Model-Version identifies the selected version after successful selection, including null scores and dependency errors.

max_annual_rate.description: Maximum annual loan rate in percent: 23.75 means 23.75%. Values outside 0..100 or more precise than 0.01 percentage point return 422.

model_version.description: Optional exact compiled model version. Omission keeps ip-v2/legal-v2; null or a non-string is 400. Empty, unknown or wrong borrower version is 422 UNSUPPORTED_MODEL_VERSION. No latest-version fallback.

input_snapshot.description: Immutable inputs of one dispatch round; disables live supplier reads. Current v2 models only.

financial_statements.description: Optional application-scoped financial statements from verified documents. For LEGAL_ENTITY only; borrower_id must match borrower.id. Takes precedence over the statements supplier; the same completeness, period, unit and reconciliation checks apply.

annual_rate.description: Annual loan rate in percent: 24 means 24%.

operation_id.description: Stable scoring round identifier. Omission preserves legacy application identity.
